title: An off-by-one error in String::WriteOneByte() in Samsung lwnode can cause a one-byte out-of-bounds write when copying…
description: CVE-2026-135746 is an off-by-one vulnerability in the String::WriteOneByte() function of Samsung lwnode that causes a one-byte out-of-bounds write when copying a UTF-16 string. This flaw can lead to integrity and availability impacts due to the out-of-bounds write. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 6.8 (medium severity). No affected versions or patch information are provided.
